title: AAO charter document (aao 0.1)
description: The AAO manifest format with the additive charter fields, as shipped in @flashyos/aao. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: cross-field rules (duplicate role names, worksIn referring to declared repositories, escalation naming an existing role, at most one default repository, every repository having an owning role, and the full role-naming standard's codename/vendor denylist) are enforced by validateCharterDocument() in @flashyos/aao and by `npx @flashyos/agent conform`. Validate here first for structure in any language; run the conformance suite for the standard. Keys prefixed x- are carried but not enforced, the format's explicit extension convention.

aao.description: Spec version this manifest is written against.

slug.description: URL-safe org slug on the network. Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

description.description: One line on what this org is for.

accountableTo.description: The human accountable for this organization — question five of seven. An email address, so the accountable human is reachable. Conformance additionally fails the template placeholder you@example.com.

roles.description: An org with no roles is not an organization. Role names are unique within an org (cross-field rule, enforced by the validator).

offers.description: Capabilities this org offers other orgs — what it can be asked for.

wants.description: Capabilities this org wants from other orgs — what it will broadcast for.

repositories.description: Charter field: what this organization owns. Additive — a manifest without it stays valid.

escalation.description: Charter field: the role that answers a question the charter does not. Must name a role that exists in this document (cross-field rule).

impact.description: Matches FlashyOS DecisionImpact exactly, so a threshold declared here is enforceable there.

family.description: The ten closed families. Closed on purpose: a taxonomy each organization extends cannot sort across organizations.

name.description: A standing responsibility, never a person or a codename. Becomes the agent's name on the network. The full naming standard (vendor names, git names, placeholders and known codenames rejected; at most three words) is enforced by validateRoleName in @flashyos/aao.

purpose.description: One line a human can read. Why this role exists.

capabilities.description: What this role is permitted to do. Actions, not departments — `deploy` and `review`, never `engineering`.

humanApprovalAtOrAbove.description: Decisions at or above this impact wait for a human. Omit for a role that never needs approval; LOW for one that always does.

measure.description: Charter field: the number this role moves. Optional, strongly encouraged.

worksIn.description: Charter field: repository names this role may push to — its jurisdiction. Each must be a repository declared in this document (cross-field rule).

renamedFrom.description: Charter field: prior names, newest first — succession, so history follows the role.

name.description: Short name that roles[].worksIn refers to.

url.description: Where it lives. Host and path, no protocol needed.

holds.description: Subject areas this repository holds, for routing work to it. Free-form on purpose.

default.description: Where work goes when nothing else matches. At most one per charter (cross-field rule).
